_provenance.note: One record per EGA policy carrying structured DUO conditions, keyed to the Data Access Committee that issues it. The DAC is the unit of institutional identity here: it is the closest observable proxy for 'one institution's terms', and is used to bound consortium cohesion from above, never to stand in for a consortium itself.
